notes: NEW ZOMBIES MAP: THE MARY JANE - CHAPTER FIVE: DEAD CALM (BETA). The boat on the horizon was the freighter that carried the Nightshade seeds. Stern deck, crew block, grow containers, engine room and the forecastle at the bow.

7 chapters, 12 tapes and a new boss: THE CAPTAIN (yes, he has the cap). Restart the ship's power, take the chief's key, burn the seed shipments, open the captain's safe and seed the ballast with the cure.
NEW WONDER WEAPON: THE HASH HARPOON. Fires a resin harpoon straight through every zombie in a line, then bursts into sticky smoke where it lands.
CARGO SLINGS swing you between the stern, both side decks and the bow once the power is back. New RIPTIDE camo for upgraded guns on this map.
Chapter four now leads into chapter five. Co-op works on the new map, host migration included.
Still in from 1.2.61 and 1.2.60: DISPENSARY ROW, SMOKE OUT, RE-UP, PUFF PUFF PASS, Season 2 HARVEST, save codes, block, word filter, error reports.
